schema.title: Invoice review
schema.description: Check the sales invoice in the item description, then choose what should happen. Approving records it in Xero as awaiting payment; nothing is emailed to the customer.

questions.label: What should happen to this sales invoice?
If approving with changes, describe them (e.g. "line 1 account 449", "all lines GST free", "due date 30 Oct")
Remember this coding for this customer?
Notes or the question for the client (optional)
